But at the end of the day, you want to think about these LLMs as their own class of agent with their own permissions, and you have to push the decisions of whether or not a given agent is allowed to do a given thing. Like it can't be strictly a question that you answer with some kind of one-size-fits-all sandbox. You have to be able to customize things at the level of the application.
